_extraction_flags.notes: Experimental demonstration of THz-over-Fiber (ToF) ISAC at 0.14 THz using OCDM waveform. Compares OCDM vs OFDM. Demonstrates superior robustness of OCDM to frequency-selective fading.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: OCDM generation (Fresnel transform). Fig 2: Experimental setup (ToF, 10km Fiber, 3.14m THz wireless). Fig 6: BER vs Photocurrent (OCDM better than OFDM). Fig 8: Subcarrier SNR (OCDM flat/robust vs OFDM deep fading). Fig 10/11: Sensing resolution (1.875 cm) identical for both.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: Proposed OCDM (Orthogonal Chirp Division Multiplexing) for ToF-ISAC. OCDM spreads information across the entire bandwidth via Fresnel transform, making it robust against frequency-selective fading (which plagues OFDM). Used in a 'Photonics-based' THz system.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: OCDM achieves BER < 3.8e-3 (HD-FEC) at lower photocurrent than OFDM (Fig 6). SNR per subcarrier is flat for OCDM, fluctuating for OFDM (Fig 8). Sensing performance (PSLR, ISLR, Resolution) is comparable to OFDM.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Strong experimental paper (JLT). Clear advantage of OCDM for *Communication* in dispersive THz/Fiber channels, while maintaining *Sensing* quality of OFDM. High relevance for 'waveform_design' and 'terahertz' categories.

bibliographic.title: THz-Over-Fiber System With Orthogonal Chirp Division Multiplexing for Integrated Sensing and Communication
bibliographic.authors: Lianyi Li, Lu Zhang, Hongqi Zhang, Zhidong Lyu, Zuomin Yang, Xiaodan Pang, Vjaceslavs Bobrovs, Oskars Ozolins, Hangbin Zhao, Feng Li, Changming Zhang, Xianbin Yu

application.scenario_description: THz-over-Fiber (ToF) ISAC system extending fiber reach to wireless THz link (3.14m) for high-rate comms and high-res sensing.

key_contribution.key_contribution: First demonstration of OCDM-based ToF-ISAC. OCDM shows superior robustness to frequency-selective fading compared to OFDM, with equal sensing resolution.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Performance degradation of OFDM-ToF ISAC due to frequency-selective fading in fiber and THz wireless links.

transmitter.notes: PM-based OFC generation. 140 GHz (0.14 THz) Carrier generated via photomixing (UTC-PD).

receiver.notes: Schottky mixer for THz downconversion to 7 GHz IF. Real-time DSO (80 GSa/s).

waveform.notes: 16-QAM OCDM. Also compared with OFDM. Bandwidth 8 GHz.

comm_metrics.notes: OCDM achieves 32 Gbps below HD-FEC. Better BER than OFDM at same photocurrent.

sensing_metrics.notes: Range resolution 1.875 cm. Radar images obtained via Zero-Padded Matched Filtering.

tradeoff.notes: OCDM improves robustness (BER) without sacrificing sensing resolution, but requires Fresnel Transform (slightly higher complexity than Fourier).
